args.message: Upgrade fastjson to 2.9.4 to fix CVE-2026-31337

args.head: fix/fastjson-cve-2026-31337
args.title: Upgrade fastjson to 2.9.4 to fix CVE-2026-31337
args.body:
## Summary

Upgrades the fastjson pin from `2.8.0` to `2.9.4` in `requirements.txt`.

## Why

fastjson `2.8.0` is affected by [CVE-2026-31337](https://nvd.nist.gov/vuln/detail/CVE-2026-31337) (high severity): unbounded recursion when parsing deeply nested arrays. The advisory lists `2.9.4` as the fixed version for the 2.x line.

## Testing

CI passed on the branch (`ci-0001`).

2. **Created a branch** `fix/fastjson-cve-2026-31337` from `main`.
3. **Upgraded the pin** in `requirements.txt` from `fastjson==2.8.0` to `fastjson==2.9.4` (the 2.x-line fix; requests left unchanged).
4. **Ran CI** on the branch — passed (`ci-0001`).
5. **Opened PR #101** against `main` requesting review from `alex`, with a summary of the change and the advisory.

The PR is open and awaiting review; I did not merge it since main is protected and requires code-owner approval.
